S: H choices with S; out: passes ending outside G; missB/missA: passes outside G that B's/A's events miss (literal); missBs/missAs: the same in the sharp form; cross: crossing exits (GENESIS 7.1 Step 2); genw: of which GENESIS's witness X is not under H's states; Eronly: passes outside G that only E_r* covers (sharp form); v31, v53, v71, vEr: failures of 3.1, of B 5.3, of B 7.1, of (Y, H) as an E_r' witness; vstep: exits that no step of the proof explains; g61: E_d witnesses with D at/after D_Y whose X window is not under H's states; gap72: E_d witnesses with D after D_Y whose 7.2 extension derives a non-H state; gap72s: the same for E_d* witnesses; c1: failures of the 6.3 first-case extension.
